name: Simi Valley Town Center
summary: Simi Valley Town Center is an upmarket lifestyle retail destination featuring quality chain stores and a distinctive cinema with in-theater dining. This well-regarded shopping center serves as Ventura County's premier gathering place, combining sophisticated retail with exceptional entertainment amenities.
demographics: Simi Valley Town Center attracts primarily middle to upper-middle class families and professionals from Simi Valley and surrounding Ventura County communities. The visitor base skews toward households with annual incomes between $75,000 and $150,000, with a strong representation of families with children and adults aged 25-54. The trade area serves a suburban population seeking convenient access to quality retail, dining, and entertainment options without traveling to Los Angeles. Shoppers typically value a mix of national retailers and experiential amenities like the cinema with in-theater dining, reflecting preferences for one-stop shopping destinations that combine practical needs with leisure activities.
description: Simi Valley Town Center stands as the premier shopping destination in Ventura County's Simi Valley community, offering a sophisticated retail experience that combines upmarket chain stores with exceptional entertainment options. Located at 1555 Simi Town Center Way, this lifestyle center has established itself as a cornerstone of the local community, drawing visitors who appreciate its refined atmosphere and carefully curated tenant mix. The center's signature feature is its state-of-the-art cinema with in-theater dining, providing a unique entertainment experience that sets it apart from traditional shopping venues. With operating hours from 10:00 AM to 9:00 PM daily, the center accommodates busy schedules while maintaining an inviting environment for leisurely shopping and dining. The property has earned strong community recognition, reflected in its 4.1-star rating from over 2,200 reviews, demonstrating consistent satisfaction among visitors who value its blend of quality retail, convenient amenities, and upscale ambiance in the heart of Simi Valley.
